findings.text: No record that the server's tests ran (Requirements, fences). The brief says "never edit Server/Events.js callers without running the server's tests", and plan.md:62 and :92 promise all `Server/*.test.mjs` before and after. session.jsonl has commits and shots, but no test result. This diff changes the class-level `"new"` event for every server subclass.

Ask 1 is only half met: `Server/Events.js` is now `class Events extends Plugin {}`, so there are still two files named Events. The static and `"new"` half lives in Plugin, not in `core/Events`. Server/readme.md names the dependency, but not the owner's second sentence: "if the server moves to its own package, Events moves with it."

Stale readme: `core/Events/readme.md` and `doc/architecture.md` still say the mixin is "`on`, `off`, `emit`", while Events.js now adds `once` and `clear` and `off` matches `listener.fn`. Neither says that class-level events and `"new"` now live in core/Plugin.

`doc/investigation.md` was copied into `core/Plugin/doc/` with its task-folder links unchanged. `[requirements.md](requirements.md)` and `[../dictate-plugins/plan.md]` now resolve inside `core/Plugin/`, where neither file exists. It also still says "this file moves there … at execute", which is now history, and every "guess" in it is unresolved.

Two plugin systems remain (law 6): `Page.use(Ext)` → `Ext.setup(page)` at `core/Page/Page.class.js:36`, and it is still advertised in `core/Page/ext/Inbox/Inbox.js:129,144,156`. design-notes.md says "no callers" and leaves it, but neither `core/Page` nor `core/Plugin` says which one a new agent should use.

Ask 7 ordering: the owner asked for `before_<name>` / `after_<name>` hooks "where needed". design-notes.md says "There is no before_/after_ split" and does not say when one would be added or why none is needed now.
Ask 8 has no follow-up task: there is no task on the session for "Voice Chat onto core/Plugin". It is mentioned only in plan.md:56 and :112, so a fresh agent would not pick it up.

Ask 6, "expandos that twirl down to each plugin's settings": no shot shows a row opened, so the slider, the scrub number and the sections are unproven. The closed rows have no disclosure arrow (shots/…/1200.png, "Try it" band), so nothing tells the reader they open.

Ask 3, "an agent can configure it all through the item tool": `Host.plugins` is an in-memory List with no page.jsonl or path. The item tool can't address it; only `.set()` deltas in code reach it. The test calls `.set()` directly.
Investigation steps were skipped: no Haiku scouts, no web search ("Prior art … from memory, guess"), and the mixin utility the brief asked for was "not found". The brief asked for all three.
"Classes using plugins right now" is written once. It doesn't redraw when a box is ticked, so "Shout (off)" stays after Shout is switched on (page.js, last section).
design-notes.md's Cost section doesn't state the owner's own line: "a game with millions of objects should hard-code its calls". Debugging risk is one short paragraph.
The live-result label is an all-caps h4 that wraps to 3 lines at 1200 (shots/…/1200.png, "Try it" band). The code block clips sideways at 400.
